The '''M4m''' was the military model of [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica's]] [[M4-series Messenger Droid/Legends|M4 Series Messenger Droid]]. It was almost identical to the civilian version, but included a small internal [[Sporting blaster/Legends|sporting blaster]] to protect the information it carried. The M4m cost 4,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], double the cost of a standard M4.<ref name="CDD" />
